scenario: An investigative journalist receives a nonprofit organization's IRS Form 990 PDF filing. They use a PDF extraction tool to convert the filing into structured Markdown, then pass key financial claims to a fact-checking service to assess the accuracy of the nonprofit's stated program expenditures and executive compensation, and finally generate a publishable investigation report summarizing the findings.
info_flow: mineru-pdf-extractor converts the Form 990 PDF to Markdown with tables → facticity-ai extracts and fact-checks financial claims from the Markdown text → reporting compiles a structured investigation report from the fact-check results.
